The run ended with Sneekers Cafe instead of McDonald's. I judge the decisive mistake to be the Orchestrator's ledger at step 9. It took the short Bing list of sit-down restaurants (plus "On the Waterfront" from Tripadvisor) as the full candidate set and sent WebSurfer to check only those. It never looked for closer late-night options such as fast-food chains. It also never compared distances, so Sneekers Cafe in Groton was accepted as the answer without confirming it was the closest eatery open at 11pm. This is a judgement call: the narrow search at step 8 and the vague instruction at step 6 also contributed.
